title: Understanding the Update Rule
text:
The update rule for logistic regression with L2 regularization is given by:

$${	heta}^{t+1}$$ $$=$$ (1-2λ)θ**(t) + \alpha[(y_i - σ(X_i * θ**(t))) * X_i]

Here, σ(z) is the sigmoid function, which is defined as σ(z) $$=$$ $$ rac{1}{1+e^{\left(-zight)}}$$.

title: Initial Conditions
text: We are given that $${\theta}^t$$ $$=$$ $$0$$. This simplifies the update rule significantly. Consider how this affects the terms in the equation.

title: Simplifying the Update Rule
text: With $${\theta}^t$$ $$=$$ $$0$$, the term σ(X_i * θ**(t)) becomes σ(0), which is $$0.5$$. Substitute this into the update rule to simplify it further.

title: Evaluating the Update Rule
text:
After substituting σ(0) $$=$$ $$0.5$$, the update rule becomes:

$${	heta}^{t+1}$$ $$=$$ $$(1-2\lambda)$$ * $$0$$ + \alpha[(y_i - $$0.5)$$ * X_i]

This simplifies to:

$${	heta}^{t+1}$$ $$=$$ \alpha(y_i - $$0.5)$$ * $$X_i$$

title: Maximizing $${\theta}^{t+1}$$
text: To make $${\theta}^{t+1}$$ as positive as possible, consider the values of $$y_i$$ and $$X_i$$. Since \alpha $$=$$ $$1$$, focus on maximizing (y_i - $$0.5)$$ * $$X_i$$.

title: Considering $$y_i$$ and $$X_i$$
text:
To maximize (y_i - $$0.5)$$ * $$X_i$$, consider the following:
- If $$y_i$$ $$=$$ $$1$$, (y_i - $$0.5)$$ is positive.
- If $$y_i$$ $$=$$ $$0$$, (y_i - $$0.5)$$ is negative.

Choose the combination of $$y_i$$ and $$X_i$$ that results in the largest positive product.
